user_prompt: 1. 将衣服颜色调整为黄色。2. 地板材质替换为木纹质感。3. 保持多视角下的动作同步和物体交互关系不变。

revision_feedback.task_scope: This is a tightly scoped restyle. Recolor only the visible clothes to yellow and replace only the floor appearance with a wood-grain material. Preserve multi-view action synchronization, object identities and counts, geometry, positions, contacts, interactions, motion, timing, camera motion, robots, people, lighting, and every other non-target appearance. Do not let yellow or wood texture bleed across object boundaries.
revision_feedback.media: Every synchronized view is exactly 30 seconds at integer 10 fps. All actions, segments, and temporal captions must cover 0:00-0:30.
revision_feedback.multiview: Files are four synchronized views of one scene. Contact-sheet columns are successive times, never a grid inside the source video. Trailing black contact-sheet cells are padding.
revision_feedback.binding: Use a concrete singular class key for each visible clothes and copy the exact phrase 'yellow' byte-for-byte into that subject's own subjects[] entry. Every visible robot hand or gripper needs a dedicated subjects[] entry carrying its exact source color and material. Explicitly own all non-target objects so the requested color cannot bleed onto them.
revision_feedback.visibility: Describe only objects and robot or person parts actually visible in each camera. Do not infer hidden limbs, labels, contact, completed actions, or exact orientation from cropped regions.
revision_feedback.length: Keep the complete native JSON concise while retaining every schema key.

source_validation_facts.media: All four views are synchronized, 30s, 10 fps, H.264/yuv420p.
source_validation_facts.scope: The requested yellow clothes and wood-grain floor are intentional target outcomes. Lighting is not a requested change and must remain source-faithful. Audit object identity and count, geometry, pose, contact, interactions, cross-view action timing, visibility, non-target appearances, robots, and people.
